fee_notes: Initial Fee is $25,000 for both Traditional and Non-Traditional Restaurants. Fee may be waived or reduced under certain circumstances, or paid in installments interest-free over 1–18 months. Multi-unit franchisees receive a credit of $25,000 per Franchise Agreement signed against the development fee (which equals $25,000 multiplied by the number of restaurants to be opened). A Satellite location requires a separate $15,000 Satellite fee. No fee is charged by the franchisor to add a co-branded Marble Slab Creamery, but MSC charges its own $25,000 initial franchise fee for that right. During fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, Initial Fees collected ranged from $0 to $25,000 for a single restaurant.
raw_excerpt: If we grant you a franchise for a Traditional Restaurant, then when you sign the Franchise Agreement, you must pay us an initial franchise fee ("Initial Fee") of $25,000. The Initial Fee for a Non-Traditional Restaurant is $25,000.
